question: Calculate the total income from Meat Lovers pizzas priced at $12 and Vegetarian pizzas at $10. Include any extra toppings charged at $1 each. Ensure that canceled orders are filtered out. How much money has Pizza Runner earned in total?
sql:
SELECT SUM(
    CASE WHEN pco.pizza_id = 1 THEN 12 ELSE 10 END + COALESCE(pge.extras_count, 0)
) as total_revenue
FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders pco
LEFT JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders prc ON pco.order_id = prc.order_id
LEFT JOIN pizza_get_extras pge ON pco.order_id = pge.order_id
WHERE prc.cancellation IS NULL
